title: ever NOIRE|Sequin Shoulder Strap Twist High Slit Prom Dress
descriptionHtml:
This Sequin Shoulder Strap Twist High Slit Prom Dress adds a bold, glamorous touch to any event. The sequin shoulder straps catch the light, while the twist detail at the waist creates a flattering shape. The high slit adds a dramatic flair, allowing for easy movement, making this dress perfect for proms or formal occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, no lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.

Occasion: Formal, Military Ball, Evening, Gala, Party
